Class KeyboardViewRouter

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.util.mvc.KeyboardViewRouter
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class KeyboardViewRouter extends Object implements Navigator
The controller for a keyboard-driven board program using KeyboardView screens.
